title: refactor(helper): update tests [PART-3]
body:
This PR mostly update the snapshots of the `SearchParameters`. We don't have [default values](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/pull/670) anymore which means that the all the snapshots are outdated. It also updates tests that was relying on this behavior.

> The CI does not pass, it's expected. It won't pass until the last PR of the stack.
